usefulness.rationale: The dossier body is empty; the only information is the identityAnchors block (name, birth date/place, Citi CEO role since March 2021 and chair since October 2025, education, McKinsey tenure) and three flagged namesake/false-conclusion items. A reader gets only bare biographical anchors with no detail on what Fraser actually did. The confusables and unjustifiedConclusions list do flag known pitfalls (two same-name individuals, rankings conflated with performance), but with no sourced claims, the dossier neither demonstrates nor disclaims knowledge gaps through content. The single retained source is an unclassified, un-extracted C-SPAN archive page, which adds no usable substance. A meeting could not be meaningfully prepared from this; only the identity anchors provide anything. No overclaims exist because there are no claims with citations to assess — the only statements in the dossier are corrections, not assertions about Fraser.
